purpose: Onboard a hire; teach 取締役/幹部/当社/既存/民営/法的/解析/自立

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新入社員に、会社の仕組みを教えています。
lines.en: I’m teaching new hires how the company works.
lines.style: patient assistant explaining, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 取締役と幹部の違いを、まず説明するといい。
lines.en: Start with the difference between directors and executives.
lines.style: boss advising, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当社の歴史も大事ですね。
lines.style: assistant adding, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 既存の部署と新規の挑戦、両方知ってほしい。
lines.en: I want them to know both existing units and new challenges.
lines.style: boss broadening scope, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 民営の競合との比較も、勉強になります。
lines.en: Comparing with private competitors is instructive too.
lines.style: assistant noting value, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 法的な知識も、業務に役立つよ。
lines.en: Legal knowledge helps the work too.
lines.style: boss emphasizing learning, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: データ解析の基礎も、教えています。
lines.en: I teach the basics of data analysis too.
lines.style: assistant noting curriculum, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 自立した社員に育ってほしいな。
lines.en: I want them to grow into independent staff.
lines.style: boss closing warmly, each word carrying genuine natural feeling
